title: 第160章 跑了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋穗说话的声音一顿，然后就听见小弟继续道。

“二姐她们这一次去府城，把带的所有货全部卖光了。我还听说，二姐和府城一个特别大的布庄定了长期供货的单子，说是以后能经常把布拉到府城去卖。”

宋承苗今年七岁，又上了一年多的私塾，明显长大了不少，说起二姐的事小嘴直叭叭的往外秃噜。

“二姐真的好厉害，娘，我以后长大了是不是也能跟着二姐去府城。”

宋承苗可太喜欢自己这位二姐了，不知道多少同龄人羡慕他有这么一个厉害的姐姐。

宋承苗早就和小伙伴们说，等自己再稍微长大点，就会去二姐手下干活，小伙伴们都很羡慕他，现在还有几个人已经认他做大哥了。

陈桂花脸上的表情也是一喜，“真的？”

宋穗看见娘露出这个表情，双手瞬间死死地握住只做了一半的鞋。

为什么？为什么还是这样？娘果然又站到宋禾那边去了，接下来，娘是不是又要劝自己忍着了？

陈桂花连忙下床穿鞋，准备去外面看热闹。

自己好歹是宋禾亲娘，现在闺女日子好过有出息了，自己怎么着也能跟着沾点好处。就算宋禾性子抠门舍不得往外拿东西，自己只要出门溜达一圈，旁人见着都得捧着说几句好听话，心里也舒坦。

宋穗见陈桂花要出门，深吸一口气，开口：“娘，你要出去见宋禾吗？”

陈桂花猛地转头，突然想起来，大闺女还在这边。

实在是大闺女每隔一段时间就过来诉苦，刚开始她还跟着一块骂，后来实在是次数太多，她都不当一回事了。

村里家家户户的日子都这样过日子，就连自己也会时不时和婆婆张老太拌嘴，于是后面每次宋穗来诉苦的时候，陈桂花就耳朵进一个耳朵出。

陈桂花道：“穗穗啊，王梅香死了丈夫，她心气不顺想找人和她吵架，你不用搭理她就行了，你平时……”

“是让我多忍忍吗。”宋穗面无表情的看着陈桂花，她就知道娘会这么说。

不知怎么的，宋穗突然想起，上一年冬天县衙赏编的那天，宋禾说的那一番话。

娘是真的对自己好，想看自己好吗？

陈桂花道：“我也不是让你忍，只是让你别整天抱怨天抱怨地的，谁家过日子不是这样？再说了……”

“你不要再说了！”宋穗猛的站起来，说话声音尖锐。

宋穗看着陈桂花冷笑一声，她算是看透了，这个世界上谁都靠不住，她想过好日子就得靠自己。

然后，宋穗便飞快跑出老宋家。

“穗穗，穗穗。”陈桂花皱眉，但到底没往心里去，自从大闺女嫁给郑枋之后，脾气一天比一天差。

“娘，大姐这是咋了？”宋承苗奇怪的问。

Page (1/3)

Song Sui's voice paused, and then she heard her younger brother continue.

"The second sister and the others went to Fucheng this time and sold out all the goods they brought. I also heard that the second sister made a long-term supply order with a very large cloth shop in Fucheng, saying that they can often sell cloths in Fucheng in the future."

Song Chengmiao is seven years old this year and has been attending private school for more than a year. She has obviously grown up a lot. When she talks about her second sister, her little mouth becomes bald.

"Second sister is really awesome. Mom, when I grow up, can I follow my second sister to Fucheng?"

Song Chengmiao liked his second sister so much that many of his peers envied him for having such a powerful sister.

Song Chengmiao has long told his friends that when he grows up a little, he will work for his second sister. His friends are all envious of him, and now a few of them have recognized him as their eldest brother.

The expression on Chen Guihua's face was also one of joy, "Really?"

When Song Sui saw her mother's expression, her hands instantly grasped the half-finished shoes tightly.

Why?Why is this still the case?As expected, my mother sided with Song He again. Next, would my mother have to persuade herself to endure it again?

Chen Guihua quickly got out of bed and put on her shoes, preparing to go outside to watch the excitement.

After all, she is Song He's mother-in-law. Now that her daughter's life is better and more promising, she can benefit from it no matter what she does.Even if Song He is stingy and reluctant to take things out, as long as he goes out for a walk, others will praise him and say a few nice words, which makes him feel comfortable.

Seeing that Chen Guihua was about to go out, Song Sui took a deep breath and said, "Mom, do you want to go out to see Song He?"

Chen Guihua turned her head suddenly and suddenly remembered that her eldest daughter was still here.

In fact, the eldest daughter came over every once in a while to complain. At first she even scolded her, but later it became so frequent that she didn't take it seriously.

Every household in the village lived like this, and even she would quarrel with her mother-in-law, Mrs. Zhang from time to time. So every time Song Sui came to complain, Chen Guihua would go in and out of one ear.

Chen Guihua said: "Suisui, Wang Meixiang's husband died. She is upset and wants to find someone to quarrel with. You just don't need to talk to her. You usually..."

"Do you want me to be patient?" Song Sui looked at Chen Guihua expressionlessly, knowing that her mother would say this.

Somehow, Song Sui suddenly remembered what Song He said on the day when the county government rewarded editors last winter.

Mom is really good to me and wants to see how well she is?

Chen Guihua said: "I'm not asking you to endure it, I'm just asking you not to complain about heaven and earth all day long. Who doesn't live like this? Besides..."

"Stop talking!" Song Sui stood up suddenly and spoke in a sharp voice.

Song Sui looked at Chen Guihua and sneered. She had finally seen through that no one in this world could be trusted. If she wanted to live a good life, she had to rely on herself.

Then, Song Sui ran out of Lao Song's house quickly.

"Suisui, Suisui." Chen Guihua frowned, but she didn't take it seriously. Ever since her eldest daughter married Zheng Fang, her temper has gotten worse day by day.

"Mom, eldest sister, what's going on?" Song Chengmiao asked strangely.
